executiveAssessment.text: Hotel Phillips Kansas City, Curio Collection by Hilton currently shows AI Consideration of 31.3% and Scenario Presence of 73.0%, with Reality Coverage at 33.3%. Strongest governed signal: Recognized across many traveler needs. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-03), material headline movement is AI Consideration 0.0 pp and Scenario Presence 0.0 pp. Independent Positioning metrics are included only where published. Independent Positioning is weak as well, so the Core and portfolio reads point in the same direction. Overall Core performance remains weak; gaps are broad across consideration, scenario coverage, and Independent Positioning. Management should prioritize correcting clear visibility and reality gaps, then address the competitors that most often appear when the property is absent.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: Hotel Phillips Kansas City, Curio Collection by Hilton appeared in at least one AI answer for 73% of the traveler needs we tested. This shows that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stay occasions.

secondaryCallout.title: Performance Risk
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 73% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 31.3% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.

managementPriority.title: Management Priority
managementPriority.body: Prioritize correcting high-severity reality gaps and the information conditions behind displacement by Loews Kansas City Hotel.
